exercises.prompt: On the map, face from reference A toward C. Give the straight-line true bearing, clockwise from north; do not follow the road curve.
hints: Use the north arrow. North is geographic, even when the screen is rotated.

exercises.prompt: Face directly from reference A toward B. Give the true bearing clockwise from north, then explain why it is not exactly east.
hints: Use the straight line between the markers rather than the screen edge.

exercises.prompt: Locate the map reference at Brown Street and Cleveland Street. Mark it and name the two street clues you used.
hints: Use both street names and the connected lines.

exercises.prompt: Locate the map reference at 161st Avenue Northeast and Cleveland Street. Mark it and explain how it differs from the Brown Street junction.
hints: Read the complete street name and compare both junctions.
